c74object.name: evi_fastskew
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_fastskew.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_fastskew.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
Very specific routines for approximations of pow(x, 0.5..2) or pow(x, 0.25..4), although also just an interesting curvature in its own right. Not accurate at all for very large 'x' in terms of pow(). Available in either param rate ('cr') or audio rate ('ar') versions (optimising for gen~ while loop). Also available with exponent set in real values (0.5..2 or 0.25..4) or as normalised input (-1..1 through 0==1).

entry.name: fastskew ( )
entry.description:
Legacy original version for pedagogy, not quite as optimised as other functions
In 1: type=input: x, Raise x to the power
In 2: type=input: skew, Must be clamped 0.5..2
Return 1: Power, 'x' to the power of 0.5..2

entry.name: n2p052 ( )
entry.description:
Linear converter around 0==1, 'curvature' -1..1 to 'exponent' 0.5..2
In 1: type=input: N, Input must be clamped -1..1
Return 1: Exponent, Output for 'skew' inputs 0.5..2

entry.name: warpcurve ( )
entry.description:
Exact converter around 0==1, 'curvature' -1..1 to 'exponent' 0.25..4 where -1 == 0.25, -0.5 == 0.5, 0 == 1, 0.5 == 2, 1 == 4
In 1: type=input: curvature, Input must be clamped -1..1
Return 1: Exponent, Output for 'skew' inputs 0.25..4

entry.name: warpcurveParam ( )
entry.description:
Like 'warpcurve()' but for computation at control rate
In 1: type=input: curvature, Input must be clamped -1..1
Return 1: Exponent, Output for 'skew' inputs 0.25..4
